description: This Dart source file defines an abstract class Retry that provides a static method to perform retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter, primarily used for network operations such as REST client and WebSocket reconnect attempts.

classes.name: Retry
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to perform retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a given asynchronous operation with retries, using exponential backoff and jitter, based on provided retry conditions and maximum attempts.

methods.name: _computeDelay
methods.description: Calculates the delay duration for the next retry attempt, incorporating exponential backoff and jitter.
